goal: Validate the local Master Data field map against real Business Central list/card/template surfaces without saving data.
whyNow: The local field map is useful, but it is not write permission. Before a narrow customer, vendor or item write gate, Business Central must show which fields, templates, dialogs and mandatory markers are actually present.
businessPurpose: Keep the data-load route realistic: one UI validation for training and screenshot truth, then a later decision for UI, Excel-assisted or configuration-package writes.
expectedOutput: A read-first result JSON with screenshots, visual-state JSON and step timeline.
Field-map validation for Customer, Vendor and Item/Service surfaces.
Explicit decision whether the next case may be a narrow write gate or must remain local/source-needed.
stopConditions: Stop if playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE is not confirmed.
Stop before clicking Save, OK, Finish, Create, Post, Preview, Validate, Apply or any template-changing action.
Stop if a dialog cannot be safely closed without saving.
Stop if screenshot QA cannot prove the target page/card/template surface.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if read-first validation proves safe non-posting customer fields and all posting/VAT/payment/template dependencies remain isolated.
Use if templates or mandatory dialogs are present but not understood enough for write.
Use if validation shows Master Data write gates are still blocked by Foundation setup gaps.
